name: Signed For

gist.Paraseed: A small creature. When one of your heroes or creatures defeats it, it moves into that hero's support zone instead of dying: that hero is poisoned for as long as it sits there, the poison cannot be healed, and it eats maximum health.
gist.Bloom, the Maniacal Botanist: Poison on any hero that carries Paraseeds hurts far more, for each Paraseed on it.
gist.Pes'zet, the Plague Bringer: Every time a creature lands in one of her heroes' support zones she adds a stack of poison to any target on the board.
gist.Klaus, the Cult Leader: When he casts a Decay spell a lower-level creature drops from her hand into his zone for free.
gist.Paraseed Greenhouse: Area: once a turn she discards a card to plant a Paraseed from the deck on one of her own heroes, or moves any number of Paraseeds on the board onto other heroes — yours included.
gist.Plant Golem: Summoned into YOUR hero's support zone: that hero cannot act. You control it and may spend your Action and a discard to destroy it.
gist.Stowaway: Summoned into any hero's support zone: that hero's effect and Abilities are off, as a curable status. Nothing else touches the Stowaway; cure the status and it is deleted.
gist.Paraseed Control: When a hero of yours dies of poison with a Paraseed on it, she revives it on her side of the table for good.
gist.Paraseed Zombie: When one of her heroes would be defeated, a Paraseed is planted on it and it stays at one health.
gist.The Warlord's Bite: Several stacks of poison at once on a target that has none.
gist.Poisoned Well: A stack of poison on everything you control.
gist.Klaus' Mom: Takes a Decay spell back out of the discard pile every turn.

plan: Cati delivers. Paraseeds are parcels: kill one with a spell and it moves into your caster's support zone, poisons him for good and shrinks his maximum health; once the Greenhouse is in play she simply re-addresses them onto your heroes herself. Bloom makes that poison savage, Pes'zet adds a stack whenever anything lands on her side, Poison Pollen stuns whatever is poisoned, and a Plant Golem or a Stowaway arrives on the hero carrying your Storm. A hero that dies of it joins her. She has almost no direct damage and her heroes are ordinary: everything depends on your sweepers and zaps opening her parcels, and on one Area.

looks.early: Two Paraseeds and a Town Guard on her side; a Plant Golem rooted in front of your caster.
looks.mid: Paraseeds sitting in YOUR support zones; the Greenhouse on the table; poison ticking.
looks.late: One of your heroes standing on her side of the table.

opening.tell: Her side holds two Paraseeds that she seems perfectly happy to lose.
opening.why: Whatever kills a Paraseed carries it home: a sweep puts every one of them into your caster's support zone. Aim at heroes, never at the parcels.

midgame.tell: Paraseed Greenhouse is in play and she is moving Paraseeds onto your heroes herself.
midgame.why: The Area is the engine now. The Yeeting takes a Paraseed out of your own zone and its poison with it, Snow Cannon on Bloom switches off the worst of the damage, and her heroes are ordinary.

crisis.tell: Your Storm caster carries two Paraseeds and a Plant Golem; Poison Pollen is coming.
crisis.why: He dies in two turns and then stands up on her side. Tea moves the curable statuses off him, The Yeeting clears a Paraseed, and keeping the carrier alive comes before everything else.

endgame.tell: Her hand is empty and the Greenhouse is gone.
endgame.why: Her heroes never hit back; all that is left on her side is parcels you should not open.
